name: Beef rolled with enoki
summary: Bò cuộn kim châm is beef rolled around enoki mushrooms and grilled, one of the cold-night grills by hồ Sa Pa.
howToEat: Eat it from the grill with the rest of the skewers.
where: The grill stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, on cold evenings.
seoTitle: Beef and enoki rolls in Sapa — a town grill
seoDescription: Bò cuộn kim châm, beef rolled around enoki and grilled, at the hồ Sa Pa stalls and on the road down to the market.
